an4.220:1.1: pe . . . asaddho hoti, dussīlo hoti, kusīto hoti, duppañño hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an4.220:2.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. Katamehi catuhi? Saddho hoti, sīlavā hoti, āraddhaviriyo hoti, paññavā hoti. Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge ti. Sobhaṇavaggo dutiyo.
an4.220:3.0: [Tass' uddānaṃ: Parisā diṭṭhi akataññutā|| pāṇātipātā pi dve maggā|| Dve vohārapathā vuttā|| hīrikaṃduppaññena] {cāti}||
